protocol: nDCG@10 retained per byte, mean over BEIR corpora scifact, nfcorpus, arguana, fiqa. '% of float' is nDCG@10 relative to the uncompressed embedding; '±' is the standard deviation across the four corpora.

float32.desc: The uncompressed embedding stored as 32-bit floats (4 bytes per dimension). The baseline every other method is measured against.

int8.desc: Each coordinate linearly scaled to an 8-bit integer (1 byte per dimension). A 4x shrink that is essentially lossless.

binary.desc: Each coordinate replaced by its sign, one bit per dimension (32x smaller than float). Candidates ranked by Hamming distance.

binary+rerank.desc: Binary Hamming search shortlists candidates, then the shortlist is re-scored with full-precision vectors. Recovers float-level quality while searching at the binary footprint.

pq.desc: Product Quantisation: split the vector into sub-vectors and encode each against a learned codebook, a few bytes per vector (Jegou et al., 2011).

rabitq.desc: A random rotation followed by 1-bit quantisation with an unbiased distance estimator, so a single 1-bit code both routes and ranks (Gao & Long, 2024).

matryoshka.desc: Truncate a Matryoshka-trained embedding to its leading dimensions: fewer dimensions at full float precision (Kusupati et al., 2022).

pca.desc: Project onto the top principal components: the classic linear dimensionality reduction, fewer dimensions at float precision.

Exact (flat).desc: Brute-force exact search over full-precision vectors: the recall ceiling and, at scale, the throughput floor.

HNSW.desc: A hierarchical navigable small-world graph. Stores the full vectors plus a graph, so it adds bytes but buys very high query throughput (Malkov & Yashunin, 2020).

IVF-PQ.desc: An inverted file over coarse centroids with product-quantised residuals: an order-of-magnitude smaller footprint at lower recall (Jegou et al., 2011).

ITQ+rerank.desc: Iterative-quantisation binary codes (16 bytes) with full-precision re-ranking of a Hamming shortlist (Gong et al., 2011).

bittrie.desc: A van Emde Boas / PATRICIA radix-trie over compact sign-codes: the sorted code array is the trie, searched coarse-to-fine, then re-ranked. Routes on an 8-byte code, reaching graph-class recall at a fraction of a graph's memory (research entry; see bitbudget bench-index).

bigann.title: 90M BigANN SIFT1B — the organisation axis
bigann.note: One method per family on a 90-million-vector slice of BigANN SIFT1B (128-d, exact ground truth), single machine, single-thread query timing. Recall@10 vs throughput vs footprint.

msmarco.title: MS MARCO 8.84M passages — compression at RAG scale
msmarco.note: The compression operators on the full MS MARCO passage corpus (8.84M passages, MiniLM-L6), nDCG@10 against graded judgements. A one-bit code with re-ranking is lossless at 32x, two orders of magnitude larger than the workstation corpora.

indexbench.title: Index benchmark — the bit-trie, head to head
indexbench.note: All four indexes on identical synthetic data (100k clustered vectors, 128-d), reproducible with `bitbudget bench-index --synthetic 100000 128`. The bit-trie routes on an 8-byte code and reaches graph-class recall at a fraction of the memory; its low QPS reflects a pure-Python reference loop, not the method itself (a compiled descent would be fast). HNSW and IVF-PQ are faiss; QPS is single-thread.
